item.title: French Government Starts 2027 Budget Showdown With Spending Caps
item.description: France’s government proposed tight spending caps across most ministries in 2027, kicking off a budget debate entangled with the uncertainty of a presidential election.

item.title: SMBC Bolsters Global Sales and Trading Push With Macro Hire
item.description: Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp. hired Kunal Maini as international head of macro rates, bolstering efforts to expand its sales and trading franchise beyond its core Japanese market.

item.title: Google Must Give Gemini Rivals Equal Access to Android System, EU Says
item.description: Google faces a European Union directive to open up its Android operating system to artificial intelligence rivals for certain features and give search data to competing online engine providers.

item.description: American drivers are once again paying more than $5 a gallon for diesel, with a fresh round of hostilities in the Middle East raising the specter of more war-induced inflation.

item.title: CXMT’s Blockbuster IPO 212 Times Covered for Retail Investors
item.description: The marquee listing of CXMT Corp. ignited a rush among retail investors as China’s homegrown memory giant opened books for an initial public offering to raise $9.8 billion, the second-largest in the nation’s history.

item.description: Abbott Laboratories raised its 2026 profit guidance after a stronger-than-expected second quarter driven by improved performance across most of its business lines.

item.title: Utility Warns Blast at South Africa Water Plant to Hit Supply
item.description: An explosion on power lines that feed a key water-pumping hub risks cutting supply to parts of South Africa’s commercial hub of Johannesburg and key platinum- and gold-mining towns to the city’s west, the continent’s biggest bulk-water supplier said.

item.description: Bond investors are demanding the most compensation since October 2022 to fund Middle Eastern governments as fighting flares again between the US and Iran.

item.title: Vital Signals Announces $399 Signal Ring That Gives Blood Pressure Readings
item.description: A three-year-old startup says it has produced a smart ring that can track blood pressure as accurately as a traditional arm cuff and that — eventually — it could be able to make medical diagnoses. If the company, called Vital Signals, can successfully deliver on the promise, it would represent a significant breakthrough in consumer wearables.

item.description: If Lionel Messi leads Argentina to an upset victory against Spain in its World Cup title defense this weekend, it will cap a profitable final stretch of games for US betting firms.

item.title: French Power Exports Jump 36% to Record on Nuclear Output Boost
item.description: French power exports surged to a record in the first half of 2026 as a rebound in nuclear output and rising renewable generation left the country with a big surplus of low-cost electricity to sell across Europe.

item.description: Brokerage and financial infrastructure startup Alpaca has raised $135 million in equity and $300 million in debt, as it looks to expand a business that helps investors trade across financial markets using artificial intelligence agents.

item.description: Atlas Copco AB’s orders blew past expectations on growing momentum at its chipmaking-exposed business, cementing the Swedish industrial company’s spot as a key beneficiary of the artificial intelligence boom.

item.description: Europe’s AI infrastructure shares have further to run as hyperscalers are expected to increase spending again next year, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s Sharon Bell.

item.title: Spain’s Naturgy to Build $344 Million Australia Renewables Plant
item.description: Spanish energy firm Naturgy Energy Group SA said its Australian unit will invest more than 300 million euros ($344 million) to build its largest renewables project in the country, combining solar power and battery storage.

item.title: Saindak Raises Security Concerns in Pakistan’s Mineral-Rich Area
item.description: Metallurgical Corp. of China-operated Saindak Metals Ltd. wants Pakistan’s government to boost security for its copper-gold mine project in its restive Southwest Balochistan, echoing warnings previously raised by Barrick Mining Corp. over surging violence in the region.

item.title: Emerging Stocks Slump as Korea Curbs Fan Selloff in Chip Giants
item.description: Emerging-market stocks resumed their slide, snapping a two-day rally, as SK Hynix Inc. and Samsung Electronics Co. tumbled after South Korean authorities moved to rein in leveraged funds tracking the chipmakers.
